purpose: Authoritative public-source registry used to replace prototype assumptions with verifiable infrastructure evidence. These sources do not constitute utility capacity commitments.
freshness_policy: Each source carries a target review interval. Source availability or proximity must never be promoted to parcel serviceability without serving-utility confirmation.

sources.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration — State Electricity Profiles
sources.use: Utility, generation, load and state electricity context; not site-specific available capacity.

sources.name: USGS Water Data for the Nation
sources.use: Observed hydrologic and water-resource context; not a municipal service commitment.

sources.name: EPA ECHO
sources.use: Permitted wastewater and environmental facility evidence; capacity must be confirmed with the serving authority.

sources.name: National Pipeline Mapping System
sources.authority: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration
sources.use: Transmission pipeline proximity/context; deliverability and pressure require utility confirmation.

sources.name: FCC National Broadband Map
sources.use: Reported broadband service availability; route diversity and enterprise capacity require provider confirmation.

IL.name: Illinois Commerce Commission
IL.use: Regulated utility filings, service-territory and infrastructure proceedings.

IN.name: Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission
IN.use: Regulated utility filings, service-territory and infrastructure proceedings.
